title: Memorial Service In Honour Of Boy Scouts Killed In

page_data.en:
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. 7733
S.I, Special Branch Section, 237
REPORT
Date February 2, 1937.
Subject memorial service in honour of boyscouts killed in Chapel - attempted distribution of anti-Japanese pictorials by members of the National Salvation Federation.
Made by D.I. Sih Tse-liang Forwarded by J. Boyd D.S.I.

A memorial service in honour of four boyscouts, who lost their lives while assisting the 19th Route Army during the 1932 Sino-Japanese hostilities, was held at 9.30 a.m. January 31 in the Shanghai Public Cemetery, Kaochingmiao, Kiangwan. About One hundred and sixty persons including 120 boyscouts and 40 boys and girls claiming to be members of the Shanghai Various Circles National Salvation Federation attended.

During the proceedings, several members of the National Salvation Federation attempted to distribute copies of a pictorial entitled "A pictorial in commemoration of the 5th Anniversary of the January 28 incident." The pamphlets were, however, seized by boyscouts and burned, while those responsible for the distribution were assaulted. Further incidents were avoided by the intervention of members of the Bureau of Police.

The service concluded at 10.30 a.m. and the assembly dispersed quietly.

A copy of the pictorial together with translation is hereto attached.

Sih Tse Liang
D. I.

S.I，特务科，237号
报告
日期：1937年2月2日。
主题：在闸北举行的纪念牺牲童子军的仪式——救国会成员试图分发反日画刊。
由督察司（D.I.）施子良呈报，经副督察长（D.S.I.）J. Boyd转呈。

1月31日上午9时30分，在江湾高境庙上海公墓举行了一场纪念仪式，以悼念在1932年中日冲突期间协助第十九路军而牺牲的四名童子军。约有160人出席，其中包括120名童子军以及40名自称是上海各界救国会成员的男女青年。

在活动过程中，几名救国会成员试图分发一份题为《纪念一·二八事变五周年画刊》的刊物。然而，这些小册子被童子军缴获并烧毁，负责分发的人员遭到殴打。由于警务处人员的介入，避免了进一步的冲突事件。

仪式于上午10时30分结束，人群安静散去。

现附上该画刊副本及其译文。

施子良
督察司（D. I.）

1) Cruel Japan starts hostilities.
2) Japanese soldiers arresting residents indiscriminately and
and massacring them.
3) Japanese soldiers setting fire to houses in Chapei.
4) The North Railway Station set on fire by Japanese planes
dropping incendiary bombs.
5) Japanese soldiers cruelly arresting residents.
6) merciless armed Japanese soldiers guarding the streets and
preventing citizens from escaping.
7) The Commercial Press and the Oriental Library on fire.
8) After killing residents, Japanese stripped them of their

The Japanese soldiers disposed of the bodies of the Chinese
residents by throwing them into the Soochow Creek. Numerous

and tragically done to death.

b) "Cease civil war, settle the Sian Revolt by peaceful means!"
c) "Unify the armed forces, extend the Suiyuan defensive war!"
d) "Release the arrested national salvation movement leaders and
pardon all political offenders!"
e) "Enforce the democratic principles and convene at once a
national conference to discuss national salvation!"
f) "Down with all Chinese traitors, eliminate all pro-Japanese
elements in the government!"

REPORT
Date January 29, 1937.

Subject Handbills bearing on the "Anniversary of the January 28 Incident"
(Sino-Japanese Conflict in Shanghai) obtained by Municipal Police
on January 28, 1937.
Made by D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa Forwarded by [Signature] D.S

Herewith attached are two handbills bearing on the
Anniversary of the January 28 Incident, which were obtained
by the Municipal Police in Western Chapel on January 28, 1937.
A summarised translation of these pamphlets is given hereunder:-
(1) Handbill entitled "Why should we commemorate the January 28
Anniversary?" dated 27/1/37, purporting to emanate from
the Shanghai Anti-Japanese and National Salvation Association"
This document denounces Gen. Chiang Kai Shek as a national
traitor and accuses him of having abolished the 19th Route
Army which had resisted the Japanese in Shanghai in dis-
regard of his order to retreat. In conclusion, the people
are urged to exterminate all pro-Japanese elements and
to unite and arm the labour and peasant masses for the
purpose of conducting a desperate struggle against
Japanese imperialism.
(2) Handbill bearing on the "Anniversary of the January 28
Incident" dated 25/1/37, purporting to emanate from the
Executive Committee of the Kiangsu Provincial Committee
of the Chinese Communist Party. This document describes
Gen. Chiang Kai Shek as a despotic dictator who enriches
himself by exploiting the people and also as a national
traitor for having contracted secret agreements with
Japan and for having failed to support the 19th Route
Army during the fighting in Shanghai. In conclusion, the
people are urged to overthrow Gen. Chiang Kai Shek and to
support the Red Armies who are fighting for national emancipation.

[Signature] D.C. (Special Branch). 29/1.
Kuh Pao Hwa
D. I.

报告
日期：1937年1月29日。

主题：工部局警务处于1937年1月28日在西区捕房查获的涉及“一·二八事变纪念日”
（上海中日冲突）的传单。
由督察司（D.I.）顾宝华呈报，经[签名] 副督察长（D.S）转呈。

现附上两份涉及一·二八事变纪念日的传单，系工部局警务处于1937年1月28日在西区捕房（Western Chapel）查获。
现将这些小册子的摘要译文列于下方：-
(1) 传单题为《我们为什么要纪念一·二八周年？》，日期为1937年1月27日，声称出自“上海抗日救国会”。
该文件谴责蒋介石将军为国贼，指控他解散了在上海抵抗日军、无视其撤退命令的第十九路军。最后，呼吁民众消灭所有亲日分子，团结并武装工农群众，以便对日本帝国主义进行殊死斗争。
(2) 传单涉及“一·二八事变纪念日”，日期为1937年1月25日，声称出自中国共产党江苏省委员会执行委员会。该文件称蒋介石将军为专制独裁者，通过剥削人民中饱私囊，并因与日本签订秘密协定以及在上海战斗期间未支持第十九路军而成为国贼。最后，呼吁民众推翻蒋介石将军，支持为民族解放而战的红军。

[签名] 助理总监（特务科）。 1月29日。
顾宝华
督察司（D. I.）

To Soochow
Departed at 12.45 p.m. January 27 :-
Mr. Wu Ting-chong, Ministry of Industry.

January 28 Anniversary - Commemoration activities
In commemoration of the anniversary of the outbreak
of Sino-Japanese hostilities in Shanghai, local radio
stations will not operate on January 28, 1937, with the
exception of the Yuen Chong Broadcasting Station, 7 San
Zang Fang, Rue du Marche, which will broadcast a special
programme bearing on the occasion, and the Shanghai City
Government Broadcasting Station, Civic Centre, which will
broadcast a programme of lectures on hygiene, education
and radio knowledge, but no musical items will be included.
The Office of the Special Kuomintang Delegate for
Seamen's Affairs will hold a meeting at 9.30 a.m. January
28 at 14 Tai Zai Li, Zao Ka Road, Nantao, in commemoration
of the occasion.
Amusement resorts in the three municipal areas of
Shanghai will operate as usual to-day. National flags
will be displayed at half mast throughout Shanghai.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. D. 7733
S.1, Special Branch 37
REPORT
Date January 27, 1937.

Subject 5th Anniversary of the Outbreak of Sino-Japanese Hostilities in
Chapel on January 28, 1937.

Made by D.I. Kuh Pao Hwa Forwarded by [Signature]

I have to report that no indications have so far
come to hand regarding the plans of local communist and/or
radical elements to stage organized demonstrations to
commemorate the 5th Anniversary of the Outbreak of Sino-
Japanese hostilities in Chapei which falls on January 28,
1937.

According to information obtained by the French Police,
members of the local National Salvation Movement have planned
to assemble at the North Railway Station at 10 a.m. January
28 and thence proceed to the Shanghai City Government,
Civic Centre, for the purpose of making an appeal for the
release of their arrested leaders.

Only one specimen copy of a handbill entitled "Pre-
pare for the Commemoration of the January 28 Anniversary,"
dated 13/1/37, purporting to emanate from the Shanghai Anti-
Japanese and National Salvation Association was obtained by
the Municipal Police on January 16. Apart from outlining
the significance of the anniversary, this document calls
for the support of the Chinese Red Army and the anti-Chiang
Kai Shek troops in their endeavour to restore the lost
territory and concludes with the following slogans:-

1. To commemorate the January 28th Anniversary, workers should
declare strikes, students suspend studies and traders
suspend business!
2. Down with Japanese imperialism!
3. Overthrow the Kuomintang who are responsible for the
decline of our country to its present state!
4. Long live the Chinese Communist Party!
5. Long live the Chinese Youth League of the Communist Party!

D.C. (Special Branch).
Kuh Pao Hwa
D. I.

报告
日期：1937年1月27日。

主题：1937年1月28日闸北中日敌对行动爆发五周年纪念。

由督察司（D.I.）顾宝华呈报，经[签名]转呈。

兹报告，截至目前，尚未收到有关当地共产党和/或激进分子计划组织示威活动以纪念1937年1月28日爆发的闸北中日敌对行动五周年的迹象。

根据法国警察获得的情报，当地救国运动成员计划于1月28日上午10时在北站集合，然后前往位于市中心的上海市政府，目的是呼吁释放其被捕领袖。

工部局警务处仅于1月16日查获一份题为《准备纪念一·二八周年》的传单样本，日期为1937年1月13日，声称出自“上海抗日救国会”。除了概述该纪念日的意义外，该文件还呼吁支持中国红军和反蒋介石部队恢复失地的努力，并以以下标语结尾：-

1. 为纪念一·二八周年，工人应罢工，学生应停课，商人应停业！
2. 打倒日本帝国主义！
3. 推翻导致我国衰败至今日境地的国民党！
4. 中国共产党万岁！
5. 共产主义青年团万岁！

助理总监（特务科）。

督察司（D. I.）

Date January 26. 19 37.

Subject Precautions taken by Chinese Police on January 28, 1937.

Made by and Forwarded by Supt. Tan Shao-liang.

Dr. Hung Chi, Chief of the 2nd Department, Police
Bureau, telephoned stating that all Police Stations under the
Police Bureau of the Shanghai City Government have received
orders to take precautions against possible trouble on January
28. All available men will be kept in barracks, made ready to
turn out any moment.

At the same time he would appreciate any information
which may be gathered by the S.M.P. and would co-operate in
every way possible. With this object in view, General Tsai
will forward a letter to the Commissioner of Police.

Tan Shaoliang
Superintendent.

C.S.
D. C. (Special Branch).

Any information obtained regarding
possible happenings on Jan. 28
will be submitted immediately.

Dr. Hung Chi, Chief of the 2nd Department, S.C.G.
Police Bureau, upon being furnished with a copy of the
translation of the attached circular, was requested to co-
operate in the taking of precautions against possible trouble on
January 28 and in tracing the source of these pamphlets so as
to check their distribution.

way but expressed the opinion that the distribution would not
have any effect on shop-keepers and students; as for the
labourers, the attention of the General Labour Union should be
called to the matter.

I communicated with the Tangpu accordingly and
requested that instructions be issued to the General Labour
Union to be on the alert.

COMMEMORATION OF THE JANUARY 28 ANNIVERSARY," dated 13.1.37,
purporting to emanate from the SHANGHAI ANTI-JAPANESE AND
NATIONAL SALVATION ASSOCIATION, which was obtained by the
Municipal Police in the Chapei area on January 14, 1937.

January 28th five years ago was the date when the
fascist Chiang Kai-shek sold Shanghai to the Japanese imperialists
whose military, aerial and naval forces bombarded Shanghai.
The same date also marks the brave resistance offered by the
Chinese troops and people as well as the defeat of the Japanese
imperialists.

As a step to attack Soviet Russia and the Chinese
Revolution, Japan, with her"bloody" measures, captured our four
North Eastern provinces in September 1931 and subsequently
invaded Shanghai.

In Shanghai, Japanese swarms were defeated by the
19th Route Army. The traitorous Chiang Kai-shek, seeing that
the continuation of war would be disadvantageous to himself
as well as Japan, despatched the 88th Army to attack the 19th
Route Army from behind. More than 70% of the troops of the
most brilliant anti-Japanese 19th Route Army lost their lives
and the war thus ended.

Were there no Chiang Kai-shek and traitors of his
kind in existence, our country would never perish and we could
maintain our independence forever.

At present a large number of the Red Armies who are
genuinely anti-Japanese and national salvation troops, together
with other anti-Chiang Kai-shek units, are gathering in the North-
West in a united front (? against Japan).

While preparing for the commemoration of the January
28th Anniversary, we should support the Red Armies and the anti-
Chiang Kai-shek troops in their endeavour to restore the lost
territory.

Our slogans are as follows:-

1) To commemorate the January 28th Anniversary, workers should

题为《准备纪念一·二八周年》的传单摘要译文，日期为1937年1月13日，声称出自“上海抗日救国会”，系工部局警务处于1937年1月14日在闸北地区查获。（注：此处原文日期与上一页所述查获日期1月16日略有出入，照实译出）

五年前的1月28日，是法西斯蒋介石将上海出卖给日本帝国主义者的日子，日军的海陆空部队随即轰炸上海。同日也标志着中国军队和人民的英勇抵抗，以及日本帝国主义的挫败。

作为进攻苏联和中国革命的一步，日本于1931年9月以其“血腥”手段攫取了我国东北四省，随后入侵上海。

在上海，日本侵略者被第十九路军击败。卖国贼蒋介石见战争持续对其自身及日本均不利，遂派遣第八十八军从背后袭击第十九路军。最杰出的抗日部队第十九路军中超过70%的官兵牺牲，战争由此结束。

若没有蒋介石及其同类卖国贼的存在，我国绝不会灭亡，我们将能永远保持独立。

目前，大量真正抗日救国的红军，连同其他反蒋部队，正在西北集结，组成统一战线（？对抗日本）。

在准备纪念一·二八周年之际，我们应支持红军和反蒋部队收复失地的努力。

我们的口号如下：

1) 为纪念一·二八周年，工人应
